## What's changed

- Added launch-time playback capability profiles for Tater Tube Player on Apple TV so the server does not repeat device capability checks before every title.
- Cached local-library and Discovery media analysis, with a fresh analysis automatically requested if a cached playback path fails.
- Improved seeking and resuming for converted local and Discovery streams by preparing a shorter startup runway while keeping the existing playback buffer for normal starts.
- Increased the HLS readiness window for slower storage and provider seeks without interrupting the frame already on screen.
- Kept the Steam player's existing inline capability reporting and playback behavior unchanged.
